spacing_and_layout.protocol: Bento Grid Protocol - MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID
spacing_and_layout.general: Dense, exact utilization of space. All cards must have h-full to match neighbors.

dashboard_cards.classes: bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-lg overflow-hidden

headers.classes: bg-[#050505]/70 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/10 z-50 sticky top-0

buttons.primary: bg-[#00F0FF]/10 text-[#00F0FF] border border-[#00F0FF]/50 hover:bg-[#00F0FF] hover:text-black hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.4)] transition-all font-mono uppercase text-sm px-6 py-2 rounded-md
buttons.god_mode: bg-[#FF003C]/10 text-[#FF003C] border border-[#FF003C]/50 hover:bg-[#FF003C] hover:text-black hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,0,60,0.4)] transition-all font-mono uppercase text-sm px-6 py-2 rounded-md

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must shift contrast. Borders light up with neon colors. Text must stay highly legible.
motion_and_interactions.entrances: Staggered fade-up for feed items and agents. Use framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.live_feed: Smooth scrolling or new items pushing down old ones seamlessly.

components.charts: Shadcn/Recharts with neon strokes (e.g. stroke='#00F0FF') and dark, semi-transparent tooltips.
components.tables: Shadcn tables with border-collapse, font-mono for numbers, hover row highlights in subtle cyan.
components.data_testid_rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

background_map.description: Dark cyberpunk city night aesthetic, to be used as a deeply faded, blurred backdrop for the main city map or god mode.

data_visualizations.description: Neon data visualization rings, useful for empty states in charts or decorative elements in the God Mode console.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark Theme + Electric & Neon archetype.
Use 'Chivo' for headings, 'IBM Plex Sans' for body, and 'JetBrains Mono' for numbers/metrics. Add them via Google Fonts.
The layout must feel like a dense, high-tech control room. Utilize the grid heavily without leaving awkward white spaces.
Use the provided image URLs for agent profiles and map backgrounds. Never use placeholder services.
Apply data-testid to all interactive and data-bearing elements.
Use Recharts for the Analytics and Economy systems, utilizing the neon hex codes (#00F0FF, #FF003C) for lines.
Ensure glassmorphism panels have a 1px border to separate them from the background.
